answer_1.quote: The main goal of an open-domain conversation model is generating appropriate responses given a conversation about any topic.

answer_2.quote: We compare SSREM with the following response evaluation methods: • BLEU • ROUGE • EMB • RUBER • RSREM

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to annotate the scores of the responses.
answer_4.guideline: How appropriate is the response overall? How on-topic is the response?
